description: This file implements a service for caching menu data locally using shared preferences, including methods to write to and read from cache, and data models to structure cached data.

classes.name: CachedMenu
classes.description: A data class representing cached menu data consisting of categories and items.

classes.name: OfflineCacheService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to persist and retrieve menu data cache.

methods.name: writeMenu
methods.description: Serializes categories and items, then stores them as a JSON string in shared preferences.

methods.name: readMenu
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON string from shared preferences, deserializes it into menu categories and items, or returns null if data is unavailable or invalid.
